parsed.why: Listed among worst states; birth-certificate marker changes banned, forcing document disclosure; state-run facility restrictions permitted; no state gender-identity discrimination or hate-crime coverage — plus the hostile national passport and entry regime.

Statewide non-discrimination including public accommodations, gender-identity hate-crime penalties, panic defence abolished, sanctuary law, court-backed facility access, low recorded incidents — all operating. Only the shared national passport and entry-screening regime pulls it down.

Executive order mandating birth-sex facilities, surgery-required documents, and a documented case of birth-sex prison placement ending in sexual assault with claims dismissed by the court — state institutions as perpetrator, plus no state protections.

'Worst Laws Passed,' legislatively erased: birth certificates list both markers, licence markers barred, facility bans, 8-1 court denying a trans teen's name change, statutory service-refusal licence, no statewide protection.

Most-Protective tier: public-accommodation and employment protections, gender-identity hate-crime reporting machinery, self-ID documents with X markers, and a care shield law helping visitors. Unenforced sodomy statutes and the shared national entry regime cap the score.
